galleryEmpty: No photos yet. Add the first one below.
uploadHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to {size} MB. Location data and other hidden details are removed.
altHint: A short description for people who cannot see the photo.
instagramHint: Paste a link to a specific post or reel, not to a profile. Example: https://www.instagram.com/p/…
instagramAdded: The Instagram post has been added.
embedDegradedNote: The link has been saved. Instagram did not provide a preview, so the post is shown as a link.
thumbnailAlt: Preview of an Instagram post by {author}
error_GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields and try again.
error_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
error_BANNED: Your account cannot publish right now.
error_NOT_FOUND: This item could not be found.
error_SERVER_ERROR: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
error_MEDIA_TYPE: This file cannot be used. Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image.
error_MEDIA_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Choose a smaller image.
error_MEDIA_DIMENSIONS: The image has too many pixels. Choose a smaller image.
error_MEDIA_LIMIT: The limit of photos and posts has been reached. Delete one to add another.
error_UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND: The upload did not finish. Please try again.
error_UPLOAD_FAILED: The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
error_EMBED_INVALID_URL: This is not a link to an Instagram post. It should look like https://www.instagram.com/p/… or https://www.instagram.com/reel/…
error_EMBED_PROFILE_URL: This is a link to a profile. Paste a link to a specific post or reel instead: open the post on Instagram and copy its link.
